**MAC failure does not advance the uplink NAS COUNT**

| | |
|---|---|
| Group | NAS / NAS security / Handling of NAS COUNT and NAS sequence number |
| Tags | negative, security |
| Verdict class | FAIL |
| Requires | Rel-15 |
| Up to | 57s at the default `--per-test-timeout` |
| Phase | stranding |
| Needs | NG Setup, registration, PDU session establishment |

## Clauses

- TS 24.501 4.4.3.3 (Rel-15 onward; Rel-16: the paragraph on the integrity algorithm's input is split into items a) and b) with a NOTE; the sentence on updating the stored NAS COUNT is unchanged from V15.0.0 through V19.8.0; Rel-18: "subclause" becomes "clause")
- TS 24.501 4.4.3.2 (Rel-15 onward, wording unchanged through Rel-19)
- TS 24.501 4.4.3.1 (Rel-16 onward; Rel-16: the stored-COUNT sentence and the estimation rules appear in V16.5.1; V15.0.0 to V16.4.0 give no estimation rules; Rel-18: "subclause" becomes "clause")

The quoted normative text and the release history of each clause are in the check's [provenance](https://github.com/grewelltech/orbit/blob/main/docs/conformance/provenance/NAS-COUNT-NOT-ADVANCED-ON-MAC-FAIL.md).
